scope_honesty: Fault tolerance: interrupted-write recovery, disk-full fail-closed, malformed-record quarantine. Analytical capture never raises into the engine that feeds the protective exit.
exit_independence: capture buffers are bounded + drop-oldest; flush runs in a thread executor OFF the event loop and is NOT in the FIRST_COMPLETED set, so it can neither block nor trigger shutdown or the mandatory protective exit.
verdict: All injected failures degrade gracefully with explicit accounting.
